title: Echo-Sync: Real-Time Edge-Optimized Sign Language Translation System
description: An end-to-end continuous sign language translator combining a 75-keypoint canonical topology with an ST-GCN foundation model for sub-100ms inference. Leverages kinematic token pruning to maintain real-time performance across variable camera frame rates.

title: DynaPrune: High-Throughput Kinematic Token Pruning & Coordinate Normalizer
description: A high-throughput Rust engine that prunes redundant skeletal frames using hand velocity thresholds to minimize inference overhead. Features SIMD-accelerated spatial normalization and cubic spline interpolation with zero-copy Python/C bindings.

title: Astride
description: A privacy friendly pedometer mobile application built with modern frameworks.

title: PDF-JSON Parser
description: A simple yet effective parser for extracting structured data from PDF files and converting it to JSON format.
